description: MEDUSA is an R microsimulation package for household distributional impacts of policy or price changes. Its README documents Spain and EU household-budget microdata, demographic groups, energy and transport poverty indices, and functions for connecting prices from other models. Users provide household records and a policy or price shock; outputs are weighted changes by income, household type and location at the survey's resolution. Current documented coverage is Spain and EU countries with the required microdata. GitHub metadata states BSD-2-Clause licensing for code; source surveys have their own access terms. A limitation is that an overnight effect model does not represent long-term household adaptation or infrastructure network operation. It can estimate who bears energy or transport transition costs in coupled infrastructure scenarios. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model can supply energy-system scenarios, but no direct MEDUSA coupling was tested. No microdata or package archive was downloaded.
inputs: Household budget microdata and policy or price shocks
name: MEDUSA household distributional microsimulation
notes: G7 G7-2031. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
